comparison.objective: Candidate separates dry finishing media from metal parts; record loads a caulking gun and seals a bath joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular sifting and bridge release; record tests release-lever/rod coordination, cartridge loading and controlled sealant deposition along a joint.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate measures recovered mass, retained washers and loss-free released seating; record measures sealed coverage, gap continuity, off-joint mess and final gun placement.
comparison.reason: Cartridge mechanism operation and continuous material deposition do not overlap meaningfully with dry screening.
